jules: Heads-up: Ambassador Labs (AMB-129) reported an overage on INV-2026-04-02. Their demo-free promo 'ambassador-demo-100' (first 100k tokens free) didn't apply for 3/29-3/31; they were charged $150. Can finance review for a retro credit?

marta: Thanks @jules. Can you paste the invoice line and the calculation they expect?

jules: INV-2026-04-02 line: tokens_standard: 125k units @ $0.0012 = $150. Promo should have zeroed first 100k -> expected credit $120 (100k * $0.0012). They asked for $120 credit.

ops-signal: Quick trace: onboarding job dropped the promo flag for accounts created during the demo cutover window. Log: ```
2026-03-29T01:03:12Z WARN promo-service: no promo record for AMB-129 created_during_cutover=true request=9f4c
```

billing-bot: Ticket created FIN-4712 to track Ambassador retro credit and remediation.

marta: Per policy, system-caused demo promo misses get retro credits. Recommend promo credit $120. Customer is small but active; propose optional $20 goodwill to smooth relationship. Total $140.

kevin: I can approve up to $200 for retention cases. Ledger note needed for GL.

marta: Ledger note: "Demo free-tier promo missed during migration cutover; applied retro credit $120 + goodwill $20. Approved by finance lead kevin." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

kevin: Approved. Create credit memo and apply to invoice (credit, no refund).

jules: Creating CM-2026-058 for $140, attaching FIN-4712 and applying to INV-2026-04-02. Posting to ledger GL SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: CM-2026-058 created and applied to INV-2026-04-02. Invoice balance updated.

ops-signal: I'll add a reconciliation query to FIN-4712 to detect any other accounts created during cutover without the demo flag and open a small infra PR to fix the flagging race.

marta: Please include the runbook snippet and sample SQL for auditors.

jules: Customer notified, they acknowledged and said thanks for the quick fix.

kevin: Mark FIN-4712 resolved once PR and runbook attached. Good work.

marta: FIN-4712 moved to resolved; CM-2026-058 attached. Closing loop.

jules: Thanks everyone :smile:
